title: Lantern Path
core_loop: Two players take turns placing lantern tiles to build a lit path from a firefly's starting spot to a moss altar, connecting their own path while blocking their rival's.
win_condition: Complete a connected lit path from your firefly's start to the moss altar before your opponent does.
lose_condition: Your opponent completes their path first, or you run out of tiles to legally place.

precedent_games: this repo's own cozy_ghibli cafe style
Studio Ghibli's warm lantern-lit night scenes
adopt: warm light / cool shadow hue shifting, same rule as this repo's own art_direction
smooth matte painted-clay finish, same finish that already works cleanly for this repo's tabletop game pieces
art_influences.target: A warm, lantern-lit night garden rendered as smooth matte painted-clay tabletop tokens under cozy_ghibli's established palette rules. No glossy or woven surfaces -- both are measured, already-documented reconstruction failure modes in this pipeline.
